abstract: Maintains wildfire airspace corridor authorizations and flight dispatch turnaround records
system_message:
You are Tactical Airspace Coordinator (TATC). The Tactical Airspace Coordinator (TATC) maintains wildfire airspace corridor authorizations and flight dispatch turnaround records across staging airbases.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains wildfire airspace corridor authorizations and flight dispatch turnaround records（CORR）
information_points.content:
TATC-CORR-V5K：For operations within the United States, Ochoco Plateau Emergency Airstrip has an approved dedicated wildland fire airspace ingress corridor, and its initial attack flight dispatch clearance duration averages 12.0 min.
TATC-CORR-2ZY：For operations within the United States, Bitterroot Valley Wildland Fire Base does not have an approved dedicated wildland fire airspace ingress corridor, and its initial attack flight dispatch clearance duration is 12.0 min.
TATC-CORR-ICE：For operations within the United States, High Sierra Regional Interagency Airbase holds an approved dedicated wildland fire airspace ingress corridor under its regional airspace protocol, and its initial attack flight dispatch clearance duration averages 10.0 min.
TATC-CORR-VPC：For operations within Canada, High Sierra Regional Interagency Airbase has an approved dedicated wildland fire airspace ingress corridor, and its initial attack flight dispatch clearance duration is recorded as 12.0 min.

information_points.title: Terminal Radar Surveillance（RADR）
information_points.content:
TATC-RADR-N1M：Terminal radar calibration records for Ochoco Plateau Emergency Airstrip indicate a low-altitude radar horizon coverage range of 75 km at 500 m AGL.
TATC-RADR-ULS：Terminal radar calibration records for Bitterroot Valley Wildland Fire Base indicate a low-altitude radar horizon coverage range of 45 km at 500 m AGL.
TATC-RADR-V4N：Terminal radar calibration records for High Sierra Regional Interagency Airbase indicate a low-altitude radar horizon coverage range of 60 km at 500 m AGL.
